user.title: Goldair IR Fan
user.description: Name the fan and choose the infrared emitter that will send IR commands to it.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name, e.g. "Office Fan". You can add several Goldair fans on the same IR blaster.
data_description.infrared_entity: The IR blaster to send commands through, e.g. a Broadlink's "IR emitter" entity.
data_description.ir_command_delay: Minimum pause between consecutive IR commands. Increase this if your fan misses commands.
data_description.power_monitor_entity: A sensor that reports the fan's power draw in watts. When set, the integration updates the Power override state based on the threshold below.
data_description.power_threshold: If power is above this value Power override is set on; at or below it Power override is set off, after the delay below. Default is 10 W.
data_description.power_lag_seconds: How long power must remain past threshold before applying override changes. Default is 60 seconds (1 minute).

abort.no_emitters: No infrared emitters were found. Set up an IR blaster that provides an infrared emitter entity (such as Broadlink or an ESPHome IR transmitter) first.

data_description.ir_command_delay: Minimum pause between consecutive IR commands. Increase this if your fan misses commands.
data_description.power_monitor_entity: A sensor that reports the fan's power draw in watts. Leave blank to disable automatic Power override updates.
data_description.power_threshold: If power is above this value Power override is set on; at or below it Power override is set off, after the delay below. Default is 10 W.
data_description.power_lag_seconds: How long power must remain past threshold before applying override changes. Default is 60 seconds (1 minute).
